scenarios: Every source face is reachable through a named preset and a valid variant
All 1560 directed face changes preserve the chosen face and reject no valid call
A compliment holds its expression through thinking, speech and listening
Quiet listening uses the calm resting face without displacing persistent affect
Question and uncertainty use restrained cues; apology and distress stay neutral
Tool waiting never replaces an explicit face or starts a speaking mouth
Mouthless faces 12 and 35 use a related speaking variant and restore when quiet
Barge-in retains the persistent face, cancels queued reactions and refuses late old-turn cues
A hundred identical calls do not restart a transition or extend its hold
Rapid conflicting calls coalesce to the latest choice at the cooldown boundary
Changing back to the current face cancels an older queued change
Automatic wording cues cannot replace a deliberate model or manual expression
Hidden-tab delays discard obsolete queued changes
A hold starts after application and entrance; cooldown waiting does not consume it
Entrance allowance does not extend duplicate calls and interruption still clears immediately
Durations are finite, invalid payloads are refused, and the face remains unchanged
10,000 deterministic mixed events keep valid faces, finite holds and interruption boundaries
limits: These checks validate expression selection, state precedence and timing policy. They do not judge rendered animation quality.
Conversation cases are deterministic text and tool traces. No live smaller model, microphone or paid voice provider was used.
State speaking must be supplied from actual audible playback; model text arrival must not start it.
